title: Deployment Parameters for Payments Service
description: Please provide the parameters for deploying the payments service to production.

change_ticket.title: Change Ticket
change_ticket.description: Enter the change ticket in the format CHG-####.

maintenance_window_start_date.title: Maintenance Window Start Date
maintenance_window_start_date.description: Enter the start date of the maintenance window in the format mm/dd/yyyy.

on_call_contact_number.title: On-Call Contact Number
on_call_contact_number.description: Enter the on-call contact number in the format (XXX) XXX-XXXX.
